title: Summoned Ward, Seal, Echo, and Record Enemy Animation Suite V4

provenance.method: Code-native pixel primitives (integer-rounded polygons, ellipses, pixel runs, and mask edge operations) rasterized at native 160x160 resolution under explicit per-family palettes by build_enemy_animation_suite_v4.py.
provenance.generatorSurface: none; no image generator, source raster, resampling, interpolation, or dithering
provenance.originalityPolicy: Original fictional designs. The Blood Ward is an invented lacquer ward-lantern, not a real reliquary, monstrance, cross, or devotional object; the Tithe Seal mark and every glyph are invented and unreadable; the Court Clone echoes Kurozane's in-game silhouette language without reproducing real heraldry; no gore.

geometry.alphaPolicy: binary; translucency is suggested with clustered transparent pixels, never partial alpha

enemies.name: Blood Ward Seal (West)
enemies.role: Father Mateus's temporary west ward object; stationary-capable, attackable, phase-two summon

enemies.name: Blood Ward Seal (East)
enemies.role: Father Mateus's temporary east ward object; mirrored wine-glass and oxidized-bronze variant of the west ward

enemies.name: Exposed Seal
enemies.role: Tithe Hound's temporary weak-point summon exposed by Consume Ink; hovering ink-and-wax registry seal

enemies.name: Court Clone
enemies.role: Kurozane's temporary command summon; umbral echo of his armored spear silhouette

enemies.name: Unfiled Testimony
enemies.role: non-hostile epilogue record gap; paper-and-ash testimony that is acknowledged, never defeated

runtimeIntegration.notes: Rows are appended after the V2/V3 families; pivots, profiles, and idle-loop flags are mirrored in game/enemy-combat-animation-atlas.mjs.
